source_work: Noah Webster, An American Dictionary of the English Language (1828)
rights_basis: The original 1828 dictionary text is public domain.
selection_method: Selected the next three high-use KJV words with exact-headword source pages after rejecting higher-ranked pages that redirected to neighboring or related entries.
review_method: Verified each page heading and entry heading in the browser, preserved the displayed wording, normalized whitespace only, and excluded any adjacent entry whose heading did not match the requested word.
guardrails: No base OCR entry was rewritten.
No neighboring-word or related-word page was accepted.
The adjacent SELF'-SEEKING paragraph on the self-same page was excluded.
No definition wording was summarized, modernized, or invented.
